name: si-a11y
description: Siteimprove accessibility for Kiro: helps you create more accessible code. It checks the HTML, CSS and framework components (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte) the agent just wrote against 26 of the 55 WCAG 2.2 A/AA criteria and steers the agent toward more accessible markup. No warranty for compliance is provided expressly or implied. Runs entirely on this machine, no account; the code being checked never leaves the machine. It does not find or fix every accessibility issue and is not a conformance statement.
